- Pilot evaluation & acceptance: complete by May 9 (target close May 15).

2) Novus to attach the security questionnaire (if already internal) or confirm the expected completion date.

Appreciate the quick confirmation, Olivia — and thanks Mark for stepping in.

Short answers to your firewall/VPC question:
- Discovery & pilot validation (initial tests): can be done via hosted endpoints using tokenized sample payloads for up to ~2 weeks — no VPC access required.
- Full infra validation, end-to-end ingestion, and performance testing will require VPC access and firewall rules (we'll need static egress IPs from Redwood).

I've incorporated your timeline notes and procurement dependency into a revised blueprint attached (v1.1). Key changes:
- Added column for "VPC required" per milestone.
- Moved target pilot start to Apr 25 (keeps pilot after procurement meeting; still targets May close if legal clears quickly).
- Highlighted legal signoff as a hard dependency.

Attachment: [Attachment: novus_engagement_blueprint_v1.1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 32KB)]

- Mark: confirm discovery kickoff availability (Mar 22–26 window).

I'll follow up Monday with a one-page executive summary and a Calendly link to lock a 30-min plan review.

Best,
Alex
